changes.title: Bulk reassign loans in the pipeline
changes.description: Managers can select multiple loans in the pipeline view and reassign them to another loan officer in one step, instead of opening each loan.
changes.customers_affected: All customers on the Pro and Enterprise plans
changes.configuration_required: No. Available to users with the Manager role.

changes.title: Document expiration reminders
changes.description: Borrower documents such as pay stubs and bank statements now show an expiration date. Loan officers get a reminder 10 days before a document expires so they can request an updated copy.
changes.configuration_required: Yes. Admins set expiration rules per document type in Settings > Documents. Default is off.

changes.title: Borrower portal: upload from phone camera
changes.description: Borrowers can take a photo of a document with their phone camera directly from the upload screen.

changes.title: Fix: pipeline report totals
changes.description: Fixed an issue where the pipeline summary report double-counted loans that had been reassigned during the month.
changes.customers_affected: Customers who use the pipeline summary report

changes.title: Faster search indexing
changes.description: Moved search indexing to a new background job to reduce load on the main database.
